1. （60 分）解答:(1)考虑电磁波在介质 a 中的传播:

$$E _ { l , a } ( z ) = E _ { l , a } ^ { + } \mathrm { e } ^ { \mathrm { i } k _ { a z } ( z - d _ { a } - l \Lambda ) } + E _ { l , a } ^ { - } \mathrm { e } ^ { - \mathrm { i } k _ { a z } ( z - d _ { a } - l \Lambda ) } \quad [ \mathrm { d } ^ { \prime } ]\tag{1}$$

利用第3个麦克斯韦方程，

$$H_{l,a,y}(z)=\frac{1}{\mathrm{i}\omega\mu_a}\frac{\mathrm{d}E_{l,a}}{\mathrm{d}z}=\frac{k_{az}}{\omega\mu_a}\left[E_{l,a}^{+}\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i}k_{az}(z-d_a-l\Lambda)}-E_{l,a}^{-}\mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i}k_{az}(z-d_a-l\Lambda)}\right]\tag{2}$$

介质b 中也有类似方程。

在介质界面上，电磁场的切向分量均连续，因此

$$E _ { l , a } ( l \Lambda ) = E _ { l , a } ^ { + } \mathrm { e } ^ { - \mathrm { i } k _ { a z } d _ { a } } + E _ { l , a } ^ { - } \mathrm { e } ^ { \mathrm { i } k _ { a z } d _ { a } } = E _ { l - 1 , b } ^ { + } + E _ { l - 1 , b } ^ { - } \quad [ 4 ]\tag{3}$$

$$H_{l,a,y}(l\Lambda) = \frac{k_{az}}{\omega \mu_a} \left( E_{l,a}^{+} \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i} k_{az} d_a} - E_{l,a}^{-} \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{az} d_a} \right) = \frac{k_{bz}}{\omega \mu_b} \left( E_{l-1,b}^{+} - E_{l-1,b}^{-} \right)\tag{4}$$

联立上面两式可以得到

$$E_{l,a}^{+} = \frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{az} d_a} \left[ \left( 1 + \frac{k_b \mu_a}{k_{a} \mu_b} \right) E_{l-1,b}^{+} + \left( 1 - \frac{k_b \mu_a}{k_{a} \mu_b} \right) E_{l-1,b}^{-} \right]\tag{6}$$

$$E_{l,a}^{-} = \frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i} k_{az} d_a} \left[ \left( 1 - \frac{k_b \mu_a}{k_a \mu_b} \right) E_{l-1,b}^{+} + \left( 1 + \frac{k_b \mu_a}{k_a \mu_b} \right) E_{l-1,b}^{-} \right]\tag{7}$$

$$M _ { \mathrm { T E } , a } = \frac { 1 } { 2 } \left( \begin{aligned} \mathrm { e } ^ { \mathrm { i } k _ { a z } d _ { a } } ( 1 + \frac { k _ { b } \mu _ { a } } { k _ { a } \mu _ { b } } ) \quad \mathrm { e } ^ { \mathrm { i } k _ { a z } d _ { a } } ( 1 - \frac { k _ { b } \mu _ { a } } { k _ { a } \mu _ { b } } ) \\ \mathrm { e } ^ { - \mathrm { i } k _ { a z } d _ { a } } ( 1 - \frac { k _ { b } \mu _ { a } } { k _ { a } \mu _ { b } } ) \quad \mathrm { e } ^ { - \mathrm { i } k _ { a z } d _ { a } } ( 1 + \frac { k _ { b } \mu _ { a } } { k _ { a } \mu _ { b } } ) \end{aligned} \right) \quad [ 4 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{9}$$

对于 $b$ 介质同理可得

$$M_{\mathrm{TE},b} = \frac{1}{2} \begin{pmatrix} \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{bz} d_b} (1 + \frac{k_a \mu_b}{k_b \mu_a}) & \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{bz} d_b} (1 - \frac{k_a \mu_b}{k_b \mu_a}) \\ \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i} k_{bz} d_b} (1 - \frac{k_a \mu_b}{k_b \mu_a}) & \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i} k_{bz} d_b} (1 + \frac{k_a \mu_b}{k_b \mu_a}) \end{pmatrix}\tag{10}$$

总的传播矩阵是

$$\begin{aligned}M_{\mathrm{TE}} = M_{\mathrm{TE},b} \cdot M_{\mathrm{TE},a} \quad & \\= \frac{1}{2} \left( \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{\mathrm{a}x} d_a} [2 \cos(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) + (\frac{k_{\mathrm{a}y} \mu_b}{k_{\mathrm{b}y} \mu_a} + \frac{k_{\mathrm{b}z} \mu_a}{k_{\mathrm{a}z} \mu_b}) \sin(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b)] - \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{\mathrm{a}x} d_a} (\frac{k_{\mathrm{a}y} \mu_b}{k_{\mathrm{b}z} \mu_a} - \frac{k_{\mathrm{b}y} \mu_a}{k_{\mathrm{a}z} \mu_b}) \sin(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) \right. & \\\left. \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i} k_{\mathrm{a}x} d_a} (\frac{k_{\mathrm{a}y} \mu_b}{k_{\mathrm{b}z} \mu_a} - \frac{k_{\mathrm{b}z} \mu_a}{k_{\mathrm{a}z} \mu_b}) \sin(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) \right. & \left. \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i} k_{\mathrm{a}x} d_a} [2 \cos(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) - (\frac{k_{\mathrm{a}z} \mu_b}{k_{\mathrm{b}z} \mu_a} + \frac{k_{\mathrm{b}z} \mu_a}{k_{\mathrm{a}z} \mu_b}) \sin(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b)] \right) & \end{aligned}\tag{11}$$

(2)p波的磁场同上一小问的电场类似，仅以 $\varepsilon$ 代替 $\mu$ 的地位。

$$M_{TM} = \frac{1}{2} \left( \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{\mathrm{a}x} d_a} \left[ 2 \cos(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) + \left( \frac{k_{\mathrm{a}} \varepsilon_b}{k_{\mathrm{b}} \varepsilon_a} + \frac{k_{\mathrm{b}} \varepsilon_a}{k_{\mathrm{a}} \varepsilon_b} \right) \sin(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) \right] - \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{\mathrm{a}x} d_a} \left( \frac{k_{\mathrm{a}} \varepsilon_b}{k_{\mathrm{b}x}} - \frac{k_{\mathrm{b}} \varepsilon_a}{k_{\mathrm{a}} \varepsilon_b} \right) \sin(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) \right. \\ \left. - \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i} k_{\mathrm{a}x} d_a} \left( \frac{k_{\mathrm{a}x} \varepsilon_b}{k_{\mathrm{b}x}} - \frac{k_{\mathrm{b}} \varepsilon_a}{k_{\mathrm{a}x} \varepsilon_b} \right) \sin(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) \right. \left. - \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i} k_{\mathrm{a}x} d_a} \left[ 2 \cos(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) - \left( \frac{k_{\mathrm{a}x} \varepsilon_b}{k_{\mathrm{b}x}} + \frac{k_{\mathrm{b}x} \varepsilon_a}{k_{\mathrm{a}x} \varepsilon_b} \right) \sin(k_{\mathrm{b}x} d_b) \right] \right)\tag{12}$$

(3) 考察相邻两个距离 Λ 的界面:

$$\boldsymbol{E}(l \cdot \Lambda) = \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} \boldsymbol{K} \Lambda} \boldsymbol{E}((l - 1) \cdot \Lambda) = \boldsymbol{M} \boldsymbol{E}((l - 1) \cdot \Lambda) \quad [\mathrm{d}']\tag{13}$$

这意味着 $\lambda = \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} K \Lambda}$ 应当是M的本征值之一，其特征方程为

$$\det(M - \lambda I) = 0\tag{14}$$

$$\lambda ^ { 2 } - \left[ 2 \cos \left( k _ { a z } d _ { a } \right) \cos \left( k _ { b z } d _ { b } \right) - \left( \frac { k _ { a z } \mu _ { b } } { k _ { b z } \mu _ { a } } + \frac { k _ { b z } \mu _ { a } } { k _ { a z } \mu _ { b } } \right) \sin \left( k _ { a z } d _ { a } \right) \sin \left( k _ { b z } d _ { b } \right) \right] \lambda + 1 = 0\tag{15}$$

$$D = 2 \cos \left( k _ { a z } d _ { a } \right) \cos \left( k _ { b z } d _ { b } \right) - \left( \frac { k _ { a z } \mu _ { b } } { k _ { b z } \mu _ { a } } + \frac { k _ { b z } \mu _ { a } } { k _ { a z } \mu _ { b } } \right) \sin \left( k _ { a z } d _ { a } \right) \sin \left( k _ { b z } d _ { b } \right)$$

$$K = \frac { 2 n \pi } { \Lambda } + \frac { 1 } { \mathrm { i } \Lambda } \ln \frac { D \pm \sqrt { D ^ { 2 } - 4 } } { 2 } , \quad n \in \mathbb { Z } \quad [ 4 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{16}$$

(4)上一小问中，式(15)可能具有实根或者复根。

$$\Delta = \left[ 2 \cos \left( k _ { a z } d _ { a } \right) \cos \left( k _ { b z } d _ { b } \right) - \left( \frac { k _ { a z } \mu _ { b } } { k _ { b z } \mu _ { a } } + \frac { k _ { b z } \mu _ { a } } { k _ { a z } \mu _ { b } } \right) \sin \left( k _ { a z } d _ { a } \right) \sin \left( k _ { b z } d _ { b } \right) \right] ^ { 2 } - 4\tag{17}$$

当 $\Delta > 0$ 时， $\lambda \in \mathcal{R}$ 对应K为纯虚数，即传播过程中指数衰减的情形。当 $\Delta \leq 0$ 时，方程有一对共轭(复)根。这两个根的乘积为1，因此二者的模必然都是1，对应K为实数，传播过程中振幅不会衰减。考虑到 $k = \omega \sqrt{\varepsilon \mu} = \sqrt{k_{z}^{2} + k_{y}^{2}}$ ，所求条件为:

$$\begin{aligned} & \left| 2 \cos \left( d _ { a } \sqrt { \varepsilon _ { a } \mu _ { a } \omega ^ { 2 } - k _ { y } ^ { 2 } } \right) \cos \left( d _ { b } \sqrt { \varepsilon _ { b } \mu _ { b } \omega ^ { 2 } - k _ { y } ^ { 2 } } \right) \right. \\& - \left. \left( \frac { \mu _ { b } } { \mu _ { a } } \sqrt { \frac { \varepsilon _ { a } \mu _ { a } \omega ^ { 2 } - k _ { y } ^ { 2 } } { \varepsilon _ { b } \mu _ { b } \omega ^ { 2 } - k _ { y } ^ { 2 } } } + \frac { \mu _ { a } } { \mu _ { b } } \sqrt { \frac { \varepsilon _ { b } \mu _ { b } \omega ^ { 2 } - k _ { y } ^ { 2 } } { \varepsilon _ { a } \mu _ { a } \omega ^ { 2 } - k _ { y } ^ { 2 } } } \right) \sin \left( d _ { a } \sqrt { \varepsilon _ { a } \mu _ { a } \omega ^ { 2 } - k _ { y } ^ { 2 } } \right) \sin \left( d _ { b } \sqrt { \varepsilon _ { b } \mu _ { b } \omega ^ { 2 } - k _ { y } ^ { 2 } } \right) \right| \leq 2 \end{aligned}\tag{18}$$

(5) 考虑式(15)的复根的实部，对于s 偏振:

$$\begin{aligned}\cos(K\Delta) = \cos\left(d_{a}\sqrt{\varepsilon_{a}\mu_{a}\omega^{2} - k_{y}^{2}}\right)\cos\left(d_{b}\sqrt{\varepsilon_{b}\mu_{b}\omega^{2} - k_{y}^{2}}\right) \\- \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\mu_{b}}{\mu_{a}}\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_{a}\mu_{a}\omega^{2} - k_{y}^{2}}{\varepsilon_{b}\mu_{b}\omega^{2} - k_{y}^{2}}} + \frac{\mu_{a}}{\mu_{b}}\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_{b}\mu_{b}\omega^{2} - k_{y}^{2}}{\varepsilon_{a}\mu_{a}\omega^{2} - k_{y}^{2}}}\right)\sin\left(d_{a}\sqrt{\varepsilon_{a}\mu_{a}\omega^{2} - k_{y}^{2}}\right)\sin\left(d_{b}\sqrt{\varepsilon_{b}\mu_{b}\omega^{2} - k_{y}^{2}}\right)\end{aligned}\tag{19}$$

对于p 偏振:

$$\begin{aligned} &\cos(K\Lambda)=\cos\left(d_{a}\sqrt{\varepsilon_{a}\mu_{a}\omega^{2}-k_{y}^{2}}\right)\cos\left(d_{b}\sqrt{\varepsilon_{b}\mu_{b}\omega^{2}-k_{y}^{2}}\right)\\ &-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\varepsilon_{b}}{\varepsilon_{a}}\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_{a}\mu_{a}\omega^{2}-k_{y}^{2}}{\varepsilon_{b}\mu_{b}\omega^{2}-k_{y}^{2}}}+\frac{\varepsilon_{a}}{\varepsilon_{b}}\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_{b}\mu_{b}\omega^{2}-k_{y}^{2}}{\varepsilon_{a}\mu_{a}\omega^{2}-k_{y}^{2}}}\right)\sin\left(d_{a}\sqrt{\varepsilon_{a}\mu_{a}\omega^{2}-k_{y}^{2}}\right)\sin\left(d_{b}\sqrt{\varepsilon_{b}\mu_{b}\omega^{2}-k_{y}^{2}}\right)\\ \end{aligned}\tag{20}$$

(1) 问28 分:(1)(2)(3)(4)(9)(10)(11) 4 分

(2) 问4分:(12)4分

(3) 问 12 分:(16)(15)(??) 4 分

2.（40 分）解答:(1.1)不考虑压缩性，连续性方程为:

$$v_{r} \cdot 2 \pi r = v_{0} \cdot 2 \pi r_{0}\tag{21}$$

$$v = - \hat{r} \frac{v_{0} r_{0}}{r} \quad [5']\tag{22}$$

(1.2)

$$\dot{r} = - \frac{v_{0}r_{0}}{r} \quad \{1'\}\tag{23}$$

$$\dot{\varphi} = \frac{C}{r^{2}} \quad [1']\tag{24}$$

消去 dt 可以得到:

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}r}{\mathrm{d}\varphi} = - \frac{v_{0}r_{0}r}{C}\tag{25}$$

$$\mathrm{d}\ln r = - \frac{v_{0}r_{0}}{C}\mathrm{d}\varphi\tag{26}$$

积分并应用边界条件:

$$\ln \frac{r}{r_{1}} = - \frac{v_{0} r_{0}}{C} \varphi\tag{27}$$

$$r = r_{1} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{v_{0} r_{0} \varphi}{C}} \quad [2']\tag{28}$$

(1.3) 设该体元的厚度为 δr，面积为 A，$\delta V = A \delta r$。两侧的压力差和科里奥利力的合力提供向心力:

$$- \hat{r} (\delta m) \frac{v^{2}}{r} = 2 (\delta m) v \times \omega - \hat{r} A \delta p\tag{29}$$

$$\frac{v^{2}}{r}=\frac{1}{\rho}\frac{\delta p}{\delta r}-2\omega v\sin\lambda\tag{30}$$

$$v = \omega r \sin \lambda \left( \sqrt{1 + \frac{1}{\rho \omega^2 r \sin^2 \lambda} \frac{\delta p}{\delta r}} - 1 \right) \quad [2']\tag{31}$$

(1.4)

$$\frac{\delta p}{\delta r} = \frac{\rho v^{2}}{r} + 2\rho\omega v\sin\lambda\tag{32}$$

最低风速为

$$v = 33 \, m/s\tag{33}$$

$$\frac{\delta p}{\delta r}=6.06 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{Pa/m} \quad[2']\tag{34}$$

(2.1) 该热机的效率不超过卡诺热机:

$$\eta \leq 1 - \frac{T_{2}}{T_{1}}\tag{35}$$

因此

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}W}{\mathrm{d}t} \leq \left(1 - \frac{T_2}{T_1}\right) \frac{\mathrm{d}Q_1}{\mathrm{d}t} \quad [\mathrm{d}']\tag{36}$$

(2.2) 水蒸气的潜热远大于其在 $T_{1}, T_{2}$ 之间的热容，故可以认为CD段的冷凝放热等于AB段的蒸发吸热。

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}Q_{1}}{\mathrm{d}t}=\frac{\mathrm{d}Q_{10}}{\mathrm{d}t}+\frac{\mathrm{d}W}{\mathrm{d}t} \quad [2']\tag{37}$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}Q_{10}}{\mathrm{d}t} \geq \frac{T_2}{T_1 - T_2} \frac{\mathrm{d}W}{\mathrm{d}t} \quad [2']\tag{38}$$

海面空气做功转化为上升气流的动能:

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}W}{\mathrm{d}t} \sim \int_{S} \rho v^{2} \cdot v \mathrm{d}S \sim \int_{0}^{R} \rho v^{3} r \mathrm{d}r \quad [2']\tag{39}$$

因此

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}Q_{10}}{\mathrm{d}t} \geq \frac{T_2}{T_1 - T_2} \int_{0}^{R} \rho v^3 r \mathrm{d}r \quad [2']\tag{40}$$

(2.3) 水蒸气的潜热为 $h^{*} - h$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}Q_{10}}{\mathrm{d}t} = \int_{S} \rho (h^{*} - h) \cdot v \mathrm{d}S \sim \int_{0}^{R} \rho (h^{*} - h) v r \mathrm{d}r \quad [5']\tag{41}$$

(2.4)

$$\int_{0}^{R} \rho (h^{*} - h) v r \mathrm{d}r \geq \frac{T_{2}}{T_{1} - T_{2}} \int_{0}^{R} \rho v^{3} r \mathrm{d}r \quad [1']\tag{42}$$

$$v \leq \sqrt{\frac{T_{1} - T_{2}}{T_{2}}(h^{*} - h)} = v_{\max}\tag{43}$$

水蒸气的质量分数为

$$x = \frac{m_{w}}{m_{a}} = \frac{M_{w}p_{s}V/(RT)}{M_{a}(p - p_{s})V/(RT)} = \frac{M_{w}}{M_{a}}\frac{p_{s}}{p - p_{s}} = 22.64 \, g/kg\tag{44}$$

海面水蒸气的比焓为

$$h_{w}^{*} = h_{w0} + c_{p,w}(T_{1} - T_{0}) = 2550 \, kJ/kg \quad [1']\tag{45}$$

因此

$$h^{*} - h = xh_{w}^{*} = 57.73 \, kJ/kg \quad [1']\tag{46}$$

$$v_{\max} \approx 170 \, m/s \quad [1']\tag{47}$$

tags: 力学/刚体转动/转动定律/质心运动定理与转动定理联立
力学/刚体转动/角动量守恒/系统角动量

电磁学/电磁力/洛伦兹力/带电粒子在电磁场中的运动
questions.content:
3.（40分）解答:(1)建立直角坐标系，原点位于初始下球球心，x轴向右，y轴向上。球的转动惯量为 $I = \frac{2}{5}mR^{2}$ 。记末态下球的角速度为 $\omega ,$ 方向指向纸内。在上球恰好接触地面时，连杆的角速度为0，上球以 $- \omega$ 旋转。能量守恒:

$$
2 m g R = 2 \cdot \frac { 1 } { 2 } I \omega ^ { 2 } + 2 \frac { 1 } { 2 } m ( \omega R ) ^ { 2 } = \frac { 7 } { 5 } m R ^ { 2 } \omega ^ { 2 }\tag{48}
$$

$$
\omega = \pm \sqrt{\frac{10g}{7R}} \quad  [3']\tag{49}
$$

在下落过程中设下球与地面间的向右的摩擦力为 $f_{c}$ 记 $( v _ { x } ^ { + } , v _ { y } ^ { + } )$ 为上球的球心平动速度， $(p_{x},p_{y})$ 为系统总动量。水平方向的动量定理:

$$
f - q v_{y}^{+} B = p_{x}\tag{50}
$$

记 $f_{1}$ 为两个球之间的摩擦力之差， $L _ { 1 } , L _ { 2 }$ 为两球的角动量，方向指向纸内。角动量定理:

$$
f_{1}R - fR = \dot{L}_{1}\tag{51}
$$

$$
f_{1}R = \dot{L}_{2}\tag{52}
$$

$$
\Rightarrow f R = \dot{L}_{2} - \dot{L}_{1} \quad [3']\tag{53}
$$

式(50)与(53)结合消去摩擦力，并作时间积分:

$$
\int _ { 0 } ^ { T } \left( p _ { x } + q v _ { y } ^ { + } B + \frac { \dot { L } _ { 1 } - \dot { L } _ { 2 } } { R } \right) \mathrm { d } t = 0\tag{54}
$$

$$
p_{x}-2qBR+\frac{L_{1}-L_{2}}{R}=0\tag{55}
$$

由于纯滚条件，末态动量可以用角速度 $\omega$ 给出:

$$
p_{x} = 2m\omega R\tag{56}
$$

$$
L_{1} = -L_{2} = I\omega\tag{57}
$$

因此

$$
\pm 2 m R \sqrt { \frac { 1 0 g } { 7 R } } - 2 q B R + \frac { 4 } { 5 } m R \sqrt { \frac { 1 0 g } { 7 R } } = 0 .\tag{58}
$$

$$
\lambda = \frac{q}{m} = \pm \frac{1}{B} \sqrt{\frac{14g}{5R}} \quad [3']\tag{59}
$$

(2)

$$
v_{d}=\omega R=\pm\sqrt{\frac{10}{7}gR}\tag{60}
$$

(3) 设最大角度为 $\theta_{0}$ 光滑的上球不会自转，能量守恒:

$$
2mgR(1 - \cos \theta) = \frac{1}{2}I\omega^{2} + m(\omega R)^{2} = \frac{6}{5}mR^{2}\omega^{2}\tag{61}
$$

$$
\omega = \pm \sqrt{\frac{5g(1 - \cos \theta)}{3R}} \quad [2']\tag{62}
$$

式(50)和式(53)仍然成立，但是

$$
L_{1} - L_{2} = I \omega = \frac{2}{5} m R^{2} \omega \quad [2']\tag{63}
$$

$$
p_{x}-2qBR(1-\cos\theta)+\frac{L}{R}=0\tag{64}
$$

带入末态动量与角动量的值:

$$
2m\omega R-2qBR(1-\cos\theta)+\frac{2}{5}mR\omega=0\tag{65}
$$

$$
\frac{12}{5}m\omega R=2qBR(1-\cos\theta)\tag{66}
$$

$$
\frac{6}{5} \omega = \lambda B (1 - \cos \theta)\tag{67}
$$

$$
\pm \frac{6}{5} \sqrt{\frac{5g(1-\cos \theta)}{3R}} = \pm \sqrt{\frac{14g}{5R}}(1-\cos \theta)\tag{68}
$$

$$
\cos \theta = \frac{1}{7} \quad [2']\tag{69}
$$

(4) 设连杆内压力为 $F  。$ 下球的角加速度和平动加速度为

$$
a_{x}^{-} = \frac{1}{m}(f_{d} - F\sin\theta)\tag{70}
$$

$$
\beta = - \frac{f_{d}R}{I} = - \frac{5f_{d}}{2mR} \quad [2']\tag{71}
$$

纯滚条件要求 $a_{x}^{-} = \beta R$ ，因此

$$
f_{d} = \frac{2}{7}F\sin\theta\tag{72}
$$

此时，上球沿连杆加速度为

$$
a_{r}^{+} = \frac{F}{m} - g \cos \theta \quad [2^{\prime}]\tag{73}
$$

下球沿连杆加速度为

$$
a _ { r } ^ { - } = a _ { x } ^ { - } \sin \theta = \frac { 1 } { m } ( f _ { d } - F \sin \theta ) \sin \theta \quad [ 2 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{74}
$$

二者必须相等，因此

$$
f _ { d } = F ( \sin \theta + \csc \theta ) - m g \cot \theta\tag{75}
$$

联立式(72)与式(75)可以解得

$$
f_{d}=\frac{2mg\sin\theta\cos\theta}{7+5\sin^{2}\theta}=-\frac{8\sqrt{3}}{583}mg\tag{76}
$$

(2)问5分:(60)5分

(4) 问 10 分:(70)(71)(73)(74)(76)2 分

tags: 电磁学/静电场/电介质极化/极化电荷面密度与电场计算
电磁学/磁场、磁介质/磁场/磁矩

questions.content:
4.（40分）解答:(1)忽略洛伦兹力，整体电荷分布呈球对称。自由电荷产生的电位移矢量为

$$D(R)=\frac{\frac{4\pi}{3}r^{3}\rho_{e}}{4\pi R^{2}}=\frac{\rho_{e}r^{3}}{3R^{2}}\tag{77}$$

$$E(R)=\frac{D(R)}{\varepsilon_{r2}\varepsilon_{0}}=\frac{\rho_{c}r^{3}}{3\varepsilon_{r2}\varepsilon_{0}R^{2}}\quad|2'|\tag{78}$$

由于自由电荷存在，球体内部有极化电荷分布。

$$D(R)=\frac{\frac{4\pi}{3}R^{3}\rho_{e}}{4\pi R^{2}}=\frac{\rho_{c}R}{3}\tag{79}$$

$$P(R)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r1}-1}{\varepsilon_{r1}}D(R)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r1}-1}{\varepsilon_{r1}}\frac{\rho_e R}{3}\tag{80}$$

$$\rho _ { b } = - \nabla \cdot \boldsymbol { P } ( \boldsymbol { R } ) = - \frac { 1 } { R ^ { 2 } } \frac { \mathrm { d } ^ { R ^ { 2 } } \boldsymbol { P } ( \boldsymbol { R } ) } { \mathrm { d } R } = - \frac { \varepsilon _ { r 1 } - 1 } { \varepsilon _ { r 1 } } \rho _ { e } \quad [ 2 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{81}$$

$$\rho = \rho _ { b } + \rho _ { e } = \frac { \rho _ { e } } { \varepsilon _ { r 1 } }\tag{82}$$

$$\sigma_{0}=P(r)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r1}-1}{\varepsilon_{r1}}\frac{\rho_{e}r}{3}\tag{83}$$

一个薄球壳具有磁矩:

$$\mathrm{d}m = \int_{0}^{\pi} 2 \pi \rho R^{2} \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta \mathrm{d}R \cdot \frac{\omega}{2 \pi} \cdot \pi (R \sin \theta)^{2} = \frac{4 \pi}{3} \rho \omega R^{4} \mathrm{d}R\tag{84}$$

总磁矩为

$$m = \frac{4\pi}{3} \sigma_0 \omega r^4 + \int_{0}^{r} \frac{4\pi}{3} \rho \omega R^4   d R = \frac{4\pi(\varepsilon_{r1} - 1)}{9\varepsilon_{r1}} \rho_0 \omega r^5 + \frac{4\pi}{15\varepsilon_{r1}} \rho_0 \omega r^5 = \left( \frac{4\pi}{9} - \frac{8\pi}{45\varepsilon_{r1}} \right) \rho_0 \omega r^5\tag{85}$$

该磁矩在外部产生偶极磁场

$$\frac{m}{4\pi} \frac{2\hat{r}\cos\theta - \hat{\theta}\sin\theta}{R^3} \quad [2']\tag{86}$$

$$B = \mu_{r2} \mu_0 H = \mu_{r2} \mu_0 \left( \frac{1}{9} - \frac{2}{45 \varepsilon_{r1}} \right) \rho_{e} \omega r^5 \frac{2 \hat{r} \cos \theta - \hat{\theta} \sin \theta}{R^3}\tag{87}$$

(2) 球壳内电极化矢量为

$$P(R)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}D(R)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}\frac{\rho_{e}r^{3}}{3R^{2}}\tag{88}$$

所求极化电荷为

$$\sigma_{1}=-P(R_{1})=-\frac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}\frac{\rho_{\mathrm{e}}r^{3}}{3R_{1}^{2}}\quad[2']\tag{89}$$

$$\sigma_{2}=P(R_{2})=-\frac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}\frac{\rho_{c}r^{3}}{3R_{2}^{2}}\tag{90}$$

(91)

球壳内磁化强度为

$$M = ( \mu _ { r 2 } - 1 ) \mu _ { 0 } H \quad [ 2 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{92}$$

面电流为

$$J_{1} = M \times \hat{n}_{1} = (\mu_{r2} - 1)\mu_{0}(\frac{1}{9} - \frac{2}{45\varepsilon_{r1}})\rho_{e}\omega r^{5}\frac{\hat{\varphi}\sin\theta}{R_{1}^{3}}\tag{93}$$

$$J_{2} = M \times \hat{n}_{2} = - (\mu_{r2} - 1)\mu_{0}(\frac{1}{9} - \frac{2}{45\varepsilon_{r1}})\rho_{e}\omega r^{5}\frac{\hat{\varphi}\sin\theta}{R_{2}^{3}}\tag{94}$$

(3) 介质球内部电场为:

$$E(R)=\frac{D(R)}{\varepsilon_{r1}\varepsilon_{0}}=\frac{\rho_{e}R}{3\varepsilon_{r1}\varepsilon_{0}}\tag{95}$$

介质球内部磁场由内部偶极和外部球壳构成。外部球壳的贡献为（匀强磁场）:

$$H_{2} = \frac{2}{3} \omega \hat{z} \left( \int_{R}^{r} \frac{\rho_{\mathrm{e}}}{\varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1}} R \mathrm{d}R + \frac{\varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1} - 1}{\varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1}} \frac{\rho_{\mathrm{e}} r}{3} \right) = \frac{2 \hat{z}}{3 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1}} \mu_{0} \omega \rho_{\mathrm{e}} \left[ - \frac{1}{2} R^{2} + \left( \frac{1}{3} \varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1} + \frac{1}{6} \right) r^{2} \right]\tag{96}$$

内部贡献为偶极场:

$$m_{1} = \int_{0}^{R} \frac{4\pi}{3} \rho \omega R^{4} \mathrm{d}R = \frac{4\pi}{15} \rho \omega R^{5}\tag{97}$$

$$H_{1} = \frac{m_{1}}{4\pi} \frac{2\hat{r}\cos\theta - \hat{\theta}\sin\theta}{R^{3}} = \frac{\rho_{c}\omega R^{2}}{15\varepsilon_{r1}}(2\hat{r}\cos\theta - \hat{\theta}\sin\theta)\tag{[H]}$$

(98)

总磁感应强度为

$$\boldsymbol { B } = \mu _ { r 1 } \mu _ { 0 } ( \boldsymbol { H } _ { 1 } + \boldsymbol { H } _ { 2 } )\tag{99}$$

评分标准:

(1) 问16 分:(78)(81)(84)(85)(86) 2 分，(83)(87) 3 分

(2) 问 14分:(88)-(92) 2 分，(93)(94)3 分

(3) 问 10分:(95)2分，(96)(98)4分

questions.title: 第 05 题
tags: 光学/几何光学/成像/球面折射与反射
光学/几何光学/像差/球差
questions.content:
5. (50分) 考虑一个半径为 $R$、折射率为 $n$ 的球透镜，平行光沿光轴入射。

(1) 考虑距离光轴 $r \ll R$ 处入射的光线，求球透镜的焦距 $f_1$。

(2) 在次低阶近似下，求焦平面上的光斑直径 $d_1$。

(3) 在球透镜后表面处，求光线出射后的焦距 $f_2$。

(4) 求焦平面上的光斑直径 $d_2$，并取 $n = 1.5, l = 0.5R$ 计算数值。
questions.analysis:
(1) 考虑距离光轴 $r \ll R$ 处入射的光线，入射角为 $i_1 = \frac{r}{R}$，出射角为 $t_1 = \frac{i_1}{n} = \frac{r}{nR}$，偏转角为 $\delta_1 = i_1 - t_1 = \frac{n-1}{n}\frac{r}{R}$。因此焦距为

$$f_1 = \frac{r}{\delta_1} = \frac{n}{n-1}R \quad [5'] \tag{100}$$

(2) 在次低阶近似下计算，记 $\eta = \frac{r}{R}$。入射角为

$$i_1 = \arcsin \eta \approx \eta + \frac{\eta^3}{6} \quad [2'] \tag{101}$$

出射角为

$$t_1 = \arcsin \frac{\eta}{n} \approx \frac{\eta}{n} + \frac{\eta^3}{6n^3} \quad [2'] \tag{102}$$

偏转角为

$$\delta_1 = i_1 - t_1 \approx \left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)\eta + \frac{1}{6}\left(1-\frac{1}{n^3}\right)\eta^3 \tag{103}$$

入射点的横坐标是

$$x_0 = R - \sqrt{R^2 - r^2} \approx \frac{\eta^2}{2}R \quad [2'] \tag{104}$$

因此折射光线的方程为：

$$y - r = -(x - x_0)\tan\delta_1 \tag{105}$$

在 $x = f_1$ 处，

$$\begin{aligned} y_1 &= r - (f_1 - x_0)\tan\delta_1 \approx r - (f_1 - x_0)\left(\delta_1 + \frac{1}{3}\delta_1^3\right) \\ &\approx R\left\{\eta - \left(\frac{n}{n-1} - \frac{1}{2}\eta^2\right)\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)\eta + \frac{1}{6}\left(1-\frac{1}{n^3}\right)\eta^3 + \frac{1}{3}\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)^3\eta^3\right]\right\} \end{aligned}$$

$$\approx -\frac{1}{2n^2}\frac{r^3}{R^2} \quad [2'] \tag{106}$$

$$d_1 = 2|y_1| = \frac{d^3}{8n^2R^2} \quad [2'] \tag{107}$$

(3) 考虑距离光轴 $r \ll R$ 处入射的光线，在后表面处入射点为 $h = r - l\tan\delta_1 = r - \left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)\frac{lr}{R}$，入射角为 $i_2 = \delta_1 + \frac{h}{R} = \left(2-\frac{1}{n}\right)\frac{r}{R} - \left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)\frac{lr}{R^2}$，出射角为 $t_2 = ni_2$，出射光线角度为 $\delta_2 = t_2 - \frac{h}{R} = (2n-2)\frac{r}{R} + \left(2-n-\frac{1}{n}\right)\frac{lr}{R^2}$。因此

$$f_2 = \frac{h}{\delta_1} = \frac{[nR - (n-1)l]R}{2n(n-1)R - (n-1)^2l} \tag{108}$$

(4) 外层光线与右侧球面的交点由以下方程组给出 $(R = 1)$

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} y &= \eta - \left(x - \frac{\eta^2}{2}\right)\tan\delta_1 \approx \eta + \frac{n-1}{2n}\eta^3 - \left(\frac{n-1}{n}\eta + \frac{n^3-2n^2+2n-1}{2n^3}\eta^3\right)x \\ y^2 &= 1 - (x-l+1)^2 \end{aligned} \right. \tag{[3']}$$

$$1 - (x-l+1)^2 = \left[\eta + \frac{n-1}{2n}\eta^3 - \left(\frac{n-1}{n}\eta + \frac{n^3-2n^2+2n-1}{2n^3}\eta^3\right)x\right]^2 \approx \eta^2\left(1-\frac{n-1}{n}x\right)^2 \tag{110}$$

$$x_2 \approx l - \frac{1}{2}\eta^2\left[\frac{n-(n-1)l}{n}\right]^2 \quad [3'] \tag{111}$$

$$y_2 \approx \eta\frac{n-(n-1)l}{n} + \frac{1}{2}\eta^3\frac{(n-1)\left[(n-1)^2l^2 - (3n^3-3n+1)l + 2n^2\right]}{n^3} \quad [3'] \tag{112}$$

入射角为

$$i_2 = \delta_1 + \arcsin y_2 \approx \delta_1 + y_2 + \frac{1}{6}y_2^3 \quad [3'] \tag{113}$$

出射角为

$$t_2 = \arcsin(n\sin i_2) \approx n(\delta_1+y_2) + \frac{1}{6}n^3(\delta_1+y_2)^3 + \frac{1}{6}ny_2^3 - \frac{1}{6}n(\delta_1+y_2)^3 \tag{114}$$

出射光线同水平方向的夹角是

$$\delta_2 = t_2 - \arcsin y_2 = n\delta_1 + (n-1)y_2 + \frac{1}{6}n^3(\delta_1+y_2)^3 + \frac{1}{6}(n-1)y_2^3 - \frac{1}{6}n(\delta_1+y_2)^3 \tag{115}$$

在焦平面上的光斑半径为：

$$\begin{aligned} y_3 &= y_2 - (f_2 + l - x_2)\tan\delta_2 \approx \\ & y_2 - (f_2 + l - x_2)\left\{n\delta_1 + (n-1)y_2 + \frac{1}{6}n^3(\delta_1+y_2)^3 \right. \\ &\left. + \frac{1}{6}(n-1)y_2^3 - \frac{1}{6}n(\delta_1+y_2)^3 + \frac{1}{3}[n\delta_1 + (n-1)y_2]^2\right\}. \end{aligned} \tag{116}$$

[3]

$$\begin{aligned} d_2 = -\frac{1}{n^2[l(n-1)-2nR]R^2} & \Big[l^4n(n-1)^4 \\ & - l^3R(7n^2-2n-1)(n-1)^3 \\ & + 2l^2R^2(9n^3-5n^2-2n+1)(n-1)^2 \\ & - lR^3(20n^5-36n^4+11n^3+11n^2-7n+1) \\ & + 2R^4n^2(4n^3-4n^2-n+2)\Big]\left(\frac{d}{2R}\right)^3 \quad [3']. \end{aligned} \tag{117}$$

在取值 $n = 1.5, l = 0.5R$ 时，

$$d_2 \approx 0.272\frac{d^3}{R^2} \quad [3'] \tag{118}$$

评分标准：

(1) 问5分：(100)5分

(2) 问 10 分：(101)(102)(106)(104)(107) 2 分

(3) 问5分：(108)5分

(4) 问 30 分：(109)-(118) 3 分

6.（50分）解答:（1）如图所示，对其进行受力分析

![](data/images/2024-ee8c02a5/2024-启慧研习院-综合-答案-1.jpg)

$$m \frac{d v}{d t} = - \mu N - m g \cos \theta\tag{1}$$

$$mg\sin\theta + N = \frac{mv^{2}}{R}\tag{2}$$

利用关系

$$d t = \frac{R d \theta}{v}\tag{3}$$

并将两式联立消去N

$$\frac{m v d v}{R d \theta} = - \mu(m g \sin \theta - \frac{m v^2}{R}) - m g \cos \theta\tag{4}$$

即

$$\frac { m d v ^ { 2 } } { 2 R d \theta } - \mu \frac { m v ^ { 2 } } { R } = - \mu m g \sin \theta - m g \cos \theta\tag{5}$$

该微分方程通解为

$$v ^ { 2 } = A e ^ { 2 \mu \theta } + \frac { 4 \mu ^ { 2 } - 2 } { 4 \mu ^ { 2 } + 1 } g R \sin \theta + \frac { 6 \mu g R \cos \theta } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } }\tag{6}$$

匹配初态

$$v^{2} = v_{0}^{2} \vert_{\theta = 0}\tag{7}$$

得到最终结果

$$v ^ { 2 } = v _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } \bar { e } ^ { 2 \mu \theta } + \frac { 4 \mu ^ { 2 } - 2 } { 4 \mu ^ { 2 } + 1 } g R \sin \theta + \frac { 6 \mu g R \cos \theta } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } } - \frac { 6 \mu g R \bar { e } ^ { 2 \mu \theta } } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } }\tag{8}$$

(2)为了能够完成越过，需要支持力始终大于0，即

$$v _ { c } ^ { 2 } = \left( - \frac { 4 \mu ^ { 2 } - 2 } { 4 \mu ^ { 2 } + 1 } g R \sin \theta e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta } - \frac { 6 \mu g R \cos \theta } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } } e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta } + \frac { 6 \mu g R } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } } + g R \sin \theta e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta } \right) _ { m i n }\tag{9}$$

对其求导可得极值位置

$$6 \mu ( - \sin \theta e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta } - 2 \mu \cos \theta e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta } ) - 3 ( \cos \theta e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta } - 2 \mu \sin \theta e ^ { - 2 \mu \theta } ) = 0\tag{10}$$

解得

$$\cos \theta = 0 \implies \theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\tag{11}$$

代入可得

$$v _ { c } = \sqrt { \frac { 6 \mu g R } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } } + \frac { 3 } { 1 + 4 \mu ^ { 2 } } g R e ^ { - \mu \pi } }\tag{12}$$

(3) 代入 $\mu = 0.2$ 可得

$$v_{c}=1.5538\sqrt{gR}\tag{13}$$

评分标准:

(4）（5）（7）（10）（13）（1）（2)3分，(9）4分，(3）（6）（8）（11）（12）5分

questions.content:
7. （40 分）解答:(1) 在其本征系中，

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}m}{\mathrm{d}\tau} = - k_{1} m\tag{119}$$

地面相对于它的速度大小 $v _ { c } ( \tau )$ 满足

$$m \delta v = - u \mathrm{d}m = k_1 u m \mathrm{d}\tau\tag{120}$$

$$v_{c}(\tau + \mathrm{d}\tau) = \frac{v_{c}(\tau) + \delta v}{1 + v_{c}(\tau)\delta v / c^{2}} = v_{c} + \delta v(1 - \frac{v_{c}^{2}}{c^{2}})\tag{121}$$

$$\mathrm{d}v_{c}(\tau)=\delta v(1-\frac{v_{c}^{2}}{c^{2}})=k_{1}u(1-\frac{v_{c}^{2}}{c^{2}})\mathrm{d}\tau\tag{122}$$

在地面系中， $\mathrm{d}t = \gamma \mathrm{d}\tau$

$$\mathrm{d}v_{c}(t) = k_{1}u(1 - \frac{v_{c}^{2}}{c^{2}})^{3/2}\mathrm{d}t\tag{123}$$

$$k_{1}ut = \int_{0}^{v_{c}} (1 - \frac{v_{c}^{2}}{c^{2}})^{-3/2} \mathrm{d}v_{c} = \frac{v_{c}}{\sqrt{1 - v_{c}^{2}/c^{2}}}\tag{124}$$

$$v_{c}=\frac{k_{1}ut}{\sqrt{1+(k_{1}ut)^{2}/c^{2}}}\tag{125}$$

(2) 由式(122)

$$\mathrm{d}v_{c}(\tau) = k_{1}u(1 - \frac{v_{c}^{2}}{c^{2}})\mathrm{d}\tau\tag{126}$$

$$k _ { 1 } u \tau = \int _ { 0 } ^ { v _ { c } } ( 1 - \frac { v _ { c } ^ { 2 } } { c ^ { 2 } } ) ^ { - 1 } \mathrm { d } v _ { c } = c \arctan \frac { v _ { c } } { c }\tag{127}$$

$$v_{c}=c\tanh\frac{k_{1}u\tau}{c}\tag{128}$$

(3) (注意不是 $\mathrm{d}p/\mathrm{d}t)$

静质量满足:
